lines: Having performed fire-natured dhāraṇā, all-marma-scorching: he should
fill the body with breath from thumb to head-end.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvamarmapratāpanīm pūrayedvāyunā dehamaṅguṣṭhānmastakāntakam
